title: Soft99: unauthorized file on online shop, personal data of up to 136,968 customers may have leaked
what_changed: Date changed from 20 November (Security NEXT publication day) to 10 November, the date of Soft99's own notice. Added that notice as the primary source; the summary now states how the file was placed (inquiry form's image-attachment function, per Soft99) instead of 'described as a backdoor', and says up to 136,968 people as the notice does, without the 'registered customers who bought by 5 November' wording.
